author: Poey, 1875

note.en: A small mullet of beaches, brackish lagoons and lower rivers, listed for this coast in Bussing & López[^2]; no other local record was found.
note.es: Una lisa pequeña de playas, lagunas salobres y partes bajas de los ríos, incluida para esta costa por Bussing y López[^2]; no se encontró otro registro local.

evidence: Listed for the Caribbean coast by Bussing & López (2010) as lisa amarilla

sources.t: Bussing & López 2010, Peces costeros del Caribe de Centroamérica meridional, Rev. Biol. Trop. 58 (Suppl. 2)

recWhy: Listed for Caribbean Costa Rica by Bussing & López; no local site.

marks.en: Silvery torpedo-shaped mullet with a broad flat head and two well-separated dorsal fins.
marks.es: Lisa plateada en forma de torpedo con cabeza ancha y plana y dos aletas dorsales bien separadas.
